source: written for this kit against workloads/todo-api/instruction.md

tests.name: register creates a user and never returns the password
register rejects a duplicate email with 409 email_taken
register validates email and password length with 400 invalid_body
login returns a token for good credentials and 401 invalid_credentials otherwise
users cannot see or change each other's todos (404 not_found)
GET /todos lists only the caller's todos, oldest first
GET /todos pages with limit and cursor, without gaps or repeats
state survives a restart when dataFile is set
the data file stores a password hash, never the password
todo routes require a bearer token (401 unauthorized)
POST /todos creates a todo with the documented shape
POST /todos validates the body with 400 invalid_body
PATCH /todos/:id updates title and done, and the change sticks
DELETE /todos/:id answers 204 and the todo is gone
